globalInvariants: Custom preferences never become official O*NET raw scores or aptitude scores.
Every highlighted field names a traceable response or user choice.
No exact career outcome is inferred from one response.
Budget estimates and pay scenarios do not alter interest evidence.
Flat/unknown/partial profiles retain useful browsing and plan routes.
Ties and mixed interests remain visible.
The full career tree remains reachable from all entry routes.
Official score imports preserve form/version/representation and missing values.
Adapted content cannot inherit the official instrument’s validation claims.
